ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/light-gray pixels occupy approximately 88% of the visible fluke area, with low-intensity black pixels defining the perimeter and focal surface marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central area is a monolithic high-intensity white block. A continuous low-intensity black boundary (10-30 pixels thick) tracks the trailing edge. Discrete dark circular rings are mapped in three primary clusters: a dense group in the mid-left lobe, a single large ring at the lower-center transition, and a sparse group on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 72 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 15% of the total vertical pixel height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, stochastic serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitudes range from 3 to 15 pixels, creating a jagged profile with localized 'notching' every 20-40 horizontal pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature originating from the median notch and extending laterally to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least 12 distinct dark-ringed circular marks (barnacle scars); highest density in the mid-left region (7 marks) and mid-right region (3 marks).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark circular scars; highly irregular, jagged tissue morphology at both distal tips with distinct black nodular protrusions.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast dark focal spot situated directly below the median notch vertex.
